ops.text: Remaining cc-notes cost: release-equivalent source uses go-git v5.19.2. requireIndex loads all pack indexes; Reindex discards the entire private map. Existing cc-notes generation guards already suppress settled unchanged misses. Upstream compatibility table still lists multi-pack-index unsupported: https://github.com/go-git/go-git/blob/main/COMPATIBILITY.md . Therefore the completed native MIDX coverage repair does not fix this backend initialization path. No redundant guard was added and no missing-object validation was removed. Source diagnosis: fundamental-efficiency/ccn-fundamental-next-cause.json. Capt ordinary raw/prepared-query resumes retain reader offsets and cursor progress; no routine restart was proven. A stateless accounting patch is reviewed and entering CI to establish remaining read origins.
